title: X Marks the Spot
intro: [mischievously] Ahoy, treasure hunters! Grab your map, your compass and your shovel, because tonight... X marks the spot! [laughs] Buried gold, secret hideouts and hidden surprises are waiting. Let's go DIGGING!

art.prompt: A weathered parchment treasure map spread on a ship captain's wooden desk, a big red X, brass compass, spyglass, gold coins spilling from a chest, candlelight and a stormy sea through a porthole Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho
categories.intro: [excited] First up, a pirate's life for me! Every clue is from Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl. Savvy?

art.prompt: A pirate galleon with tattered black sails gliding through moonlit Caribbean fog, glowing lanterns, gold coins on the deck Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl, Johnny Depp plays this rum-loving captain
clues.reveal: The correct answer is CAPTAIN Jack Sparrow! [chuckles] He'd want me to say captain.

clues.clue: Captain Barbossa sails this ship with the famous black sails
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Black Pearl, the fastest ship in the Caribbean... allegedly.

clues.clue: In the moonlight, Barbossa's cursed crew is revealed to be these
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is skeletons! Moonlight shows them for what they really are. Spooky AND bony.

clues.clue: Jack's magical compass doesn't point north; instead it points to this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is whatever you want most! [sighs] If only mine pointed to the nearest churro stand.

clues.clue: The cursed Aztec gold is hidden in a cave on this island, which cannot be found except by those who already know where it is
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is Isla de Muerta, the Island of the Dead! You found it, so you must have known already.

categories.title: Hidden Treasures
categories.intro: [whispers] Shhh... these treasures are hidden all over Disney movies. Find them and the points are yours!

art.prompt: A secret cave glittering with heaps of gold, jewels and an ornate oil lamp on a stone pedestal, beams of light from above Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Aladdin, Jafar needs a diamond in the rough to enter this tiger-headed cave full of treasure
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Cave of Wonders! [laughs] Rule one: touch nothing but the lamp.

clues.clue: In Peter Pan, Captain Hook kidnaps this princess to find out where Peter's hideout is
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tiger Lily! Hook wanted the hideout, but he got a crocodile instead.

clues.clue: In Atlantis: The Lost Empire, Milo uses this ancient book to find the lost city
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Shepherd's Journal! Talk about a page-turner.

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Madame Medusa makes little Penny search a pirate cave for this giant diamond
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Devil's Eye! [chuckles] Penny hid it in her teddy bear. Smart kid.

clues.clue: In this 1990 animated movie, Scrooge McDuck hunts for the lost treasure of the thief Collie Baba
clues.answer: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
accept: ducktales the movie treasure of the lost lamp
choices: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp! Woo-oo!

clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pinocchio! A real wooden head-scratcher.

categories.title: Park Treasure Hunt
categories.intro: [excited] Disney Parks are PACKED with secrets, gold and hidden surprises. Let's go hunting!

art.prompt: A theme park adventure land at dusk with jungle vines, a rustic rope bridge, a mine train track and a treasure chest half buried in sand Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Imagineers hide these three-circle shapes all over the parks for eagle-eyed guests to spot
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hidden Mickeys! [whispers] There's probably one near you right now.

clues.clue: More than 300 animal carvings are hidden in the trunk of this Animal Kingdom icon
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tree of Life! Look closely and you'll spot lions, eagles and more.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Big Thunder Mountain Railroad races through this flooded old mining town
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tumbleweed! [laughs] Their rainmaker did his job a little TOO well.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Indiana Jones Adventure takes you into the Temple of this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Temple of the Forbidden Eye! [gasps] Whatever you do, don't look into its eyes.

clues.clue: A members-only club with its own restaurant hides behind an unmarked door in Disneyland's New Orleans Square
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Club 33! [mischievously] Very exclusive... and very, VERY secret.

categories.title: Off the Map
categories.intro: [chuckles] Grab your atlas! Name these Disney places you won't find on any regular map.

art.prompt: A fantastical hand-drawn world map with a floating island, an undersea kingdom, a tropical island and a cloud-topped mountain, parchment edges curling Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Peter Pan and the Lost Boys live on this island
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Neverland! Second star to the right and straight on till morning.

clues.clue: Ariel grows up in this undersea kingdom ruled by her father, King Triton
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Atlantica! [excited] Life is the bubbles, under the sea!

clues.clue: Lilo and Stitch live on this Hawaiian island
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kauai, the Garden Isle! Ohana means family.

clues.clue: In Hercules, Zeus and the other gods live on top of this mountain
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mount Olympus! [laughs] Great view, terrible commute.

clues.clue: In Raya and the Last Dragon, the lands of Kumandra (Fang, Heart, Spine, Talon and Tail) are named after the parts of this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a dragon! The whole map is shaped like one. Sisu would be proud.
